exposure: Mode of delivery (assisted breech delivery, vacuum delivery, forceps delivery, C-section, spontaneous vaginal delivery)
cohort: 110 mothers expecting twins at the Department of Gynecology and Obstetrics Unit ll, Sandeman Provincial Teaching Hospital Quetta.
finding: Most perinatal deaths were observed in C-section deliveries, and all were among unbooked cases, potentially due to insufficient patient information leading to a higher rate of C-sections and subsequent fetal deaths.
